title: MCQ: What is printed?
prompt:
What is printed?

```java
System.out.print((double)(7 / 2));
System.out.print(" ");
System.out.print((double) 7 / 2);
```

A. `3.0 3.5`
B. `3.5 3.5`
C. `3.0 3.0`
D. `3.5 3.0`

Print your answer as: the option letter, then your explanation of why it is correct and why each other option is wrong. First line must start with the letter.

tests.name: A A
tests.code:
String out = CjTestBase.capture(() -> Solution.program());
CjTestBase.checkTrue(out.startsWith("A"), "the chosen option's explanation (starts with the letter)");
tests.hint: A. The first divides two ints first (7/2 = 3), THEN widens to 3.0; the second casts 7 before dividing, giving 3.5. B assumes the cast retroactively fixes the first expression; C/D miss which operand the cast binds to.
